subject: Integrator Launchpad & 'SkillBundle' enablement — partnership proposal
messages:
From: Tom Erickson <tom@catalyst-consulting.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@morgantech.io>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner enablement idea — 'SkillBundle' launchpad

Hi Aditya,

Appreciate the intro last week. Catalyst Consulting has been fielding increasing demand from clients to get their SI teams up to speed quickly on inference platforms with prescriptive, hands-on enablement. We sketched a two-track offering (technical ramp + GTM readiness) we call the "SkillBundle."

High-level asks:
- A 6-week enablement program focused on small-medium SI teams (6-12 engineers/consultants).
- Joint materials (labs, reference prompts, policy checklist) and a quick cert "launchpad" badge.
- An estimate of Redwood-led delivery capacity for a pilot (1 live workshop + 3 office-hour sessions).

Can your team put together a lightweight scope and rough pricing? Wed like to move quickly to lock dates for a November pilot with one of our enterprise accounts.

Attachments: none on this note.

Best,
Tom Erickson
Partnerships, Catalyst Consulting

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Tom Erickson <tom@catalyst-consulting.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner enablement idea — 'SkillBundle' launchpad

Tom — thanks, this aligns well with what we've been validating with other integrators. Quick proposal below for the pilot scope and estimate. Looping Laura for delivery/ops.

Proposed Pilot: Integrator Launchpad "SkillBundle" (6 weeks)
- Week 0: Pre-work + discovery (customer use-cases, data sensitivity)
- Week 1: Architecture + deployment patterns (hosted/dedicated/private paths)
- Week 2: Prompt engineering + evals (client-specific evals + regression detection)
- Week 3: Performance tuning (batching, quantization recommendations)
- Week 4: Workshop (4-hr hands-on lab) + cert check
- Weeks 5-6: Post-workshop office hours + success checklist handoff

Estimated Redwood resourcing for pilot: 1 Solutions Engineer (lead, 40% time), 1 Platform PM (15%), 1 Technical Trainer (for workshop). Price guidance: $28k USD flat fee for the pilot (materials + 3 live sessions) + optional per-seat certification at $200/person.

Deliverables included: syllabus (draft attached), lab environment config snippets, evaluation harness, launch checklist.

I attached a draft syllabus (Launchpad_SkillBundle_Syllabus.pdf) and a suggested agenda (MOP-accelerator-agenda.xlsx). Let me know if Catalyst wants us to include a co-branded slide deck.

Next step: pick pilot week (we can support the week of Nov 9 or Nov 16).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Launchpad_SkillBundle_Syllabus.pdf (PDF, 180KB)
Attachment: MOP-accelerator-agenda.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tom Erickson <tom@catalyst-consulting.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner enablement idea — 'SkillBundle' launchpad

Adding a few operational notes from delivery:

- SLA / support: For the pilot we provide 3 office-hour windows (2 hours each) and a shared Slack channel; for broader programs we require a minimum 30-day lead for environment provisioning.
- Security/compliance: If the client requires VPC/private deployment proofs, Redwoods Early Access checklist and audit sample are available — we'll need a short questionnaire back from Catalyst before the workshop.
- Billing / contract: We can do a simple SOW (pilot scope + acceptance criteria) under the existing partner master agreement. Aditya, can you attach the SOW template?

Laura Bennett
Head of Partner Delivery | Redwood Inference
